text:
Sophie (PM): Quick sync — launch has settled enough for a focused 2-week post-launch iteration. Proposal: small, high-impact slice that balances customer fixes + one or two delight bets. Scope guard: no task > 3 dev-days unless it's a P1 bug. Goal: ship Monday next week. Please reply with 'take' for ownership or :thumbsup: if you agree.

Amar (ENG): +1. Can we pull the top customer-reported issues from the triage board and lock owners? I can pick one of the infra-y bugs.

Nora (CS): From customer triage (top signal): streaming latency spikes, embed vector drift (edge cases), billing export failures on retry, occasional token-count mismatch in long chats, and a UI copy/flow confusion reported by two pilot customers.

Jin (SRE): Streaming latency looks like batching thresholds + a degraded GPU kernel on 2/3 of the Dedicated pool. I can run the rollout for an adjusted batch window tomorrow afternoon. If someone owns verification tests, I can push the patch.

Leo (Design): For delight bets I have two small things: (A) 1-click \"Copy answer\" micro-UX (low effort, high polish), (B) conversational breadcrumbs (shows previous five prompts as collapsible history). A is <1d, B is ~2-3d.

Sophie (PM): OK — here's how I'd like to structure decisions:
- Bugs: highest-severity customer-facing issues (P1/P2) get immediate ownership, aim to finish in 48–72h.
- Enhancements: reserve ~30% capacity for 1–2 micro-bets (<=3 dev-days).
- Backlog: pick up 1 tech-debt item only if it unblocks multiple bugs.

Sophie (PM): Quick priority scoring heuristic (super rough):
```
score = impact(1-5) + urgency(1-5) - dev_days/2
apply to top items to break ties
```
(we'll use this to decide between same-priority items)

Amar (ENG): I can take the memory leak on long-chat sessions (#375). Estimated 2d to reproduce + fix + quick e2e. 'take'

Jin (SRE): I'll take streaming latency (#342). Will do a canary of adjusted batch window + kernel selector rollback path. ETA: patch & canary by EOD tomorrow. 'take'

Nora (CS): I'll own customer verification & repro steps for token-count mismatch (#351) and billing export retry (#370) — I can surface exact repros and prioritized customer list. 'take'

Sophie (PM): Great. That leaves the small UX request and embeddings drift. Leo — do you want to own Copy Answer micro-UX?

Leo (Design): Yes — I'll ship a tiny design + annotated spec today. 'take' for Copy Answer (A). For embeddings drift, we should gate by a reproducible test. Could be model-level or data change.

Amar (ENG): I can look at embeddings drift (#365) if Nora can provide repro prompts/inputs. Might be a model-ops issue or quantization edge-case. Estimate 3d if it is infra/model, 1d if it's a prompt/format bug.

Sophie (PM): Plan summary (actionable):
- Jin: streaming latency canary + fix. Patch by tomorrow EOD. (verify: Jin + Nora)
- Amar: memory leak on long-chat (#375). Target 2d. (verify: Nora)
- Nora: repro + customer verification for token mismatch & billing export. Target: today afternoon.
- Leo: ship Copy Answer micro-UX (<=1d). Dev owner TBD (Amar/ENG to pick up small front-end task).
- Amar: initial triage for embeddings drift after Nora's repro.

Sophie (PM): Constraints/reminders:
- If a bug becomes P1, we pull it into immediate hotfix track (no delays).
- Keep enhancements cap: <=3 dev-days each.
- No new exploratory spikes unless paired with a measurable hypothesis & owner.

Amar (ENG): I'll take the FE work for Copy Answer if Jin ok with juggling? Should be a small PR + unit tests. 'take FE'

Jin (SRE): Fine with that. I'll handle the canary infra bits separately.

Nora (CS): Repros: I'll drop a doc in the triage board and ping owners. Linking here: https://go/repro/PL-1743 (private).

PatchBot: Deployment scheduled: canary slot reserved for streaming-latency patch at 2026-03-23T15:00Z (auto message).

Sophie (PM): Final check — if no objections, we close scope and I'll create a short follow-up plan in the iteration doc with owners + acceptance criteria. Acceptances should include: repro steps, customer sign-off (if applicable), and metrics to watch (p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-count variance). 

Leo (Design): :thumbsup:

Amar (ENG): :thumbsup:

Jin (SRE): :thumbsup:

Nora (CS): I'll ping customers after fixes and collect sign-off.

Sophie (PM): Thanks — I'll update the iteration doc and add a tiny checklist for launch-readiness:
- QA pass on canary
- Customer verification (Nora)
- Rollback playbook (Jin)
- Post-rollout monitoring (Amar)

Sophie (PM): Action items assigned. If anything blocks, call the release war-room channel.

Amar (ENG): Noted. Will create PRs and link back here.

Jin (SRE): Will post canary results in this thread.

Nora (CS): Will add customer notes to the triage doc and DM owners.

Sophie (PM): Closing thread — thanks all.
